paite: TOUPA, na puanin ah kua ahong zintung dia? Na mual siangthou ah kua hong om ding?
heading: Pathian Thiltup David La
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

paite: Diktak a om, kizentak a hih a, alungtang a thutak genmi pen.
english: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

paite: Alei a mi gense ngei lou a, alawm tung a thil hihkhial ngei lou a, a-invengte min leng gense ngeiloumi pen.
english: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

paite: Migilou muhsit in a-om nak hi; TOUPA laudan siamte apahtawi hi. Amah a ding a poi ding nangawn kichiam khin a hihlamdang ngei lou mi.
english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

paite: Apung delh ding a asum leitawisak loumi, asiam zaw siam lou tangsak ding a golhna leng la ngeiloumi pen. Huchibang thilhihmi, Bangchik mah in aling kei ding hi.
english: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
